scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-ideathon "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mjs"

scripts.test:e2e:large: firebase emulators:exec --only database,auth,storage --project demo-ideathon "node scripts/seed-event.mjs --teams=150 --judges=160 --unmarked-judges=10 --rooms=50 && cross-env E2E_EVENT_SIZE=large E2E_ROUND_ONE_JUDGES=160 playwright test e2e/event-sizes.spec.mjs --project=desktop"
